# General AI Agent Platform (Dev’ai Controller)
# Architectural Baseline Specification Version 2.0 (7-Step Canonical Autonomous Lifecycle & Governance Standard)

> Generalized AI Agent Platform engineered for production execution on Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub, and Resend.

## 1. What the Platform Is
Dev’ai Controller is a generalized AI Agent Platform rather than a single chatbot. It combines:
1. Multi-Agent Orchestration (General, Developer, Knowledge, Customer Service, Design, Custom agents).
2. 7-Step Canonical Autonomous Lifecycle & Governance Standard governing all workflows.
3. Knowledge Layer with Title IDs, chunking, and semantic vector retrieval (Cloudflare Vectorize + R2).
4. Tool Registry & Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients across GitHub, Figma, Resend, and Cloudflare.
5. Natural-Language Automations Engine with 9 lifecycle states: WORKING, DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, SCHEDULED, ACTIVE, PAUSED, COMPLETED, FAILED, INACTIVE.
6. Deterministic Workflow Engine with consequential action approval gates ([CANCEL] vs [APPROVE]).
7. Embeddable Customer Service Widget (`/widget.js`) with isolated permissions and bounded knowledge.
8. Cloudflare Edge Runtime with native bindings (`AI`, `DB` D1, `STORAGE` R2, `VECTOR_INDEX` Vectorize, `CONFIG_KV`, `AGENT_SESSION` Durable Objects, `triggers`/Cron Triggers).
9. Zero-Trust secret isolation (AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with 96-bit IVs and zero browser exposure).
10. Immutable audit log ledger sealed with SHA-256 cryptographic hashes.

## 2. The 7-Step Canonical Autonomous Lifecycle & Governance Standard
Every autonomous execution follows this strict 7-stage sequential pipeline:
1. Understand the Request: Validates caller tenant boundary, sanitizes prompt injections, and parses parameters.
2. Build the Executive Plan: Formulates deterministic DAG, maps required tools from Tool Registry, evaluates permission risk, and sets SLA budget.
3. Retrieve Necessary Knowledge or Prepare Tool Call: Dispatches semantic search against Cloudflare Vectorize for attached Title IDs and pre-validates MCP tool inputs.
4. Approval Gate: Safe queries bypass; consequential mutations (email, git commit, edge deploy) halt for explicit operator cryptographic token.
5. Execute Approved Action: Dispatches finalized payloads via authorized MCP, Resend, or GitHub APIs with retry backoffs.
6. Verify Outcome & Compare Results to Expected Resources: Asserts actual returned state against expected resource schema to guarantee zero drift.
7. Audit Log: Records every step, action result, verification outcome, and approval token in an immutable ledger with SHA-256 cryptographic hash.

## 3. Core Architectural Principle
AI plans and interprets.
Knowledge supplies factual context.
Tools perform actions.
Workflow Engine executes deterministic steps.
Permissions control access.
Approval controls consequential actions.
Cloudflare executes production workloads.
GitHub is the authoritative source-of-truth repository.

## 4. Agents Registry
- **General Agent (`agent-general-01`)**: Primary orchestrator formulating execution plans, knowledge retrieval, and tool dispatches across 7 canonical lifecycle stages.
- **Developer Agent (`agent-developer-01`)**: Codebase specialist integrated with GitHub REST API and Cloudflare Workers for surgical AST diffs, PR dispatches, and edge deployment automation.
- **Knowledge Agent (`agent-knowledge-01`)**: Document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, and factual truth verification engine.
- **Customer Service Agent (`agent-customer-01`)**: Isolated, zero-privilege embeddable customer representative for public webchats and widget embeds.
- **Design Agent (`agent-design-01`)**: Interface & design system specialist integrated with Figma MCP for token inspections and component specs.
- **Custom Agent (`agent-custom-01`)**: Configurable edge agent tailored for multi-step webhook ingestion and database reconciliations.

## 5. Controlled Tool Registry & MCP Architecture
Tools are dynamically discoverable and permission-enforced:
- `knowledge.search`: Semantic vector search across tenant-authorized documents.
- `knowledge.add`: Ingest, chunk, and index a document with an immutable Title ID.
- `email.send`: Transactional email dispatch via Resend API pipeline (Requires Approval).
- `email.schedule`: Registers a cron schedule in Cloudflare Cron Triggers (Requires Approval).
- `github.read`: Inspect directory trees, files, commits, and branches.
- `github.write`: Commit surgical AST patch to designated branch (Requires Approval).
- `github.pull_request`: Create PR with verification checklist and summary (Requires Approval).
- `figma.read`: Read typography, color palettes, and component tokens.
- `figma.create`: Create design component specs.
- `cloudflare.read`: Read active worker versions, environments, and health.
- `cloudflare.deploy`: Deploy edge release to Cloudflare global network (Requires Approval).
- `agent.call`: Invoke sub-agent (e.g., General Agent -> Design Agent -> Result).
- `task.schedule`: Schedule deterministic workflow execution on Cloudflare triggers.
- `workflow.run`: Execute workflow step sequence with audit logging.

## 6. Knowledge Architecture & Title IDs
Knowledge objects are independent from the agent and reusable across workflows.
Each knowledge object has a unique `Title ID`:
- `operava-canonical-7-step-execution-framework-v1` (7-step canonical execution & governance standard)
- `multi-agent-orchestration-protocol-v1` (Task delegation hierarchies and state contracts)
- `company-branding-v2` (JSON brand palette, gradient `#ff6b35` -> `#f38020` -> `#9333ea`, typography)
- `human-in-the-loop-approval-gates-v2` (Consequential action policies and risk matrix)
- `zero-trust-secret-isolation-v1` (Zero-trust credential security policies)
- `monthly-client-email-v1` (HTML executive briefing template)
- `signature-template` (HTML executive email signature)

## 7. Cloudflare Workers AI Model & Prompt Template
Primary Model: `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`
Binding: `env.AI`

Worker Invocation Pattern:
```javascript
const aiRes = await env.AI.run('@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct', {
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: 'You are an autonomous agent enforcing the 7-step canonical governance standard: (1) Understand Request, (2) Build Plan, (3) Retrieve Knowledge, (4) Approval Gate, (5) Execute Action, (6) Verify Outcome vs Expected Resources, (7) Audit Log with SHA-256 hash.'
    },
    { role: 'user', content: prompt }
  ],
  max_tokens: 1024,
  temperature: 0.2
});
```

## 8. API Specification (/v1 & /api Namespaces)
- `GET /api/health`: Edge status, airport colocation, and active Cloudflare bindings.
- `GET /api/status`: Operational status of Cloudflare, Supabase, GitHub, and Resend.
- `GET /v1/agents`: List authorized agents.
- `GET /v1/agents/:id`: Retrieve agent profile and permissions.
- `GET /v1/agents/:id/flow`: Retrieve 7-step structure flow.
- `GET /v1/agents/:id/knowledge`: Retrieve attached knowledge references.
- `POST /v1/agents/:id/simulate-flow`: Execute 7-step pipeline simulation with verification & SHA-256 hash.
- `GET /v1/tools`: List discoverable tools in the Tool Registry.
- `GET /v1/mcp`: List connected MCP servers.
- `GET /v1/knowledge`: List attached knowledge items with Title IDs.
- `POST /v1/knowledge`: Ingest new document with Title ID.
- `GET /v1/automations`: List automations filtered by status.
- `POST /v1/automations/parse`: Natural-language automation parser.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/approve`: Approve consequential action.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/cancel`: Cancel automation proposal.
- `POST /v1/automations/:id/run`: Immediate execution ("Run Now").
- `GET /v1/executions`: Execution audit trail with approval tokens & SHA-256 hashes.
- `GET /v1/widget/config`: Embeddable customer widget configuration.
- `POST /v1/widget/chat`: Customer service chat endpoint.
- `GET /widget.js`: Static client widget script.
- `POST /api/coding/execute`: Cloudflare Workers AI coding engine producing AST patches.

## 9. Cloudflare Deployment Architecture
- `wrangler.toml`: Complete configuration with bindings:
  - `[ai]`: Cloudflare Workers AI (`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`)
  - `[[d1_databases]]`: SQLite relational data
  - `[[r2_buckets]]`: Documents & assets
  - `[[vectorize]]`: Semantic vectors
  - `[[kv_namespaces]]`: Token cache
  - `[durable_objects]`: Stateful sessions
  - `[triggers]`: Scheduled crons
  - `[site]`: Frontend static directory (`./dist`)

## 10. Development & Verification Commands
- `npm run build`: Compiles Vite frontend SPA and bundles server.
- `npm run lint`: Validates syntax with `tsc --noEmit`.
- `npx wrangler deploy`: Deploys standalone `cloudflare-worker.js` to Cloudflare.
- `npx wrangler dev`: Runs local Cloudflare Worker emulation.
